title: Gaze Collector
description: Collect any block by looking at it. The block you're staring at is added to your inventory.
body:
# Gaze Collector

Why mine blocks when you can simply look at them?

Gaze Collector lets you collect blocks directly into your inventory by looking at them. Explore caves, gather resources, and obtain rare blocks without ever swinging a pickaxe.

Whether you're searching for diamonds, exploring the Nether, or creating chaotic challenge runs, every block becomes a potential reward. The mod works naturally as you play and creates a completely different survival experience where observation is more important than mining.

Features:

* Collect blocks by looking at them.
* Works with a wide variety of blocks, including normally unobtainable ones.
* No mining required.
* Perfect for challenge runs, speedruns, and custom adventures.
* Simple and lightweight gameplay mechanic.

Notes:

* Mobs and dropped items are ignored.
* Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer.
